Commentary.Commentary: For New Zealand, Jeetan Patel got those two wickets and apart from him no one really threatened. In fact, you can say the Indian batsmen were out mostly in pursuit of quick runs. Let's see how the visitors fight back from here. Stay tuned for the fourth innings.

INDIA HAVE DECLARED ON 216/3! So that was expected, India were just waiting for Pujara's ton and Kohli has declared after it, giving New Zealand a TARGET OF 475! The hosts scored quick runs and have given New Zealand almost four and a half sessions to bat now. Gambhir scored a quick fifty whereas Pujara got his century. Rahane was fluent as well in his short innings.
Down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick but misses.
8th Test Century up for Pujara.

FOUR! CENTURY! On the pads, Pujara pulls it down to the fine leg region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. That will bring up Pujara's century as well. The dressing room applauds and his wife gives a standing ovation as well. Well played!
Fullish outside off, Rahane mistimes it towards wide long off for a single.
Width on off outside off, Pujara guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball around off, Pujara whips it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Low full toss on off, Pujara works it through square leg for a couple.

DRINKS BREAK! 50-run partnership up for Pujara and Rahane in just 48 balls. They have upped the ante and are taking the game away from the visitors. The lead has already swelled past 450 and a declaration might just be around the corner. The skipper might be waiting for Pujara to complete his century.
On a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Dug in short, it doesn't zip through because of the slow nature of the pitch. Rahane camps back and gets a bit of an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, Pujara lunges and drives it hard to long off for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
On a length around off, Rahane makes room and takes a couple of steps down the track. He looks to hit it through covers but gets a bottom edge towards the leg side for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Rahane opens the face of the bat and plays it towards point.
Matt Henry is back into the attack.
On a length outside off, Pujara steers it through backward point for a couple.
Short ball around middle and leg, pulled through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Full length ball directed at the stumps, Rahane makes rooms and creams it elegantly through the cover region and the ball races to the fence.
Rahane pre-meditates and comes down to have a swing. Neesham varied his length seeing him come down the pitch and beats him.
Fuller and outside off, Rahane looks to nudge it to through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Full around middle and leg, worked down to fine leg for a single.
Jimmy Neesham is back.
FOUR! Good shot! Rahane steps down the track and converts it into a full toss and hits it beautifully down the ground for a superb boundary.
Pujara works it behind square leg for a single.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Floated up outside off, Rahane comes down the track and drives it firmly through the covers for a single.
Fullish around middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
FOUR! That's whacked! Shortish delivery on off, Pujara rocks back and pulls it aerially over mid-wicket for a gorgeous boundary. He moves on to 87, his highest score in the series.
A tad short outside off, Pujara cuts it towards point.
Flighted outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Delicate from Rahane! Short and wide this time, Rahane camps back and plays it fine beating the fielder at short third man and the ball races to the fence.
Short ball, Pujara pulls it down to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Rahane goes for the cut but doesn't get it off the meat of his bat and through to cover point for a single.
Tossed up ball, Rahane sweeps it fiercely towards deep mid-wicket. Ronchi runs across and dives full length to restrict the batsmen to two.
Very full on off, Pujara digs it towards mid on.
Full around middle and off, flicked towards short mid-wicket.

Pushed quicker through the air outside off and fullish in length, Rahane waits for it and cuts it late towards the fielder at short third man. He runs to his left and hurls in a throw at the striker's end. The throw is wide, if it was a direct hit, Pujara would have been gone according to the replays.
Loopy delivery outside off, Rahane looks to drive but gets an inside edge on to his pads.
Tossed up on off, Rahane brings out the fancy reverse sweep  but fails to beat the short third man fielder.
Full and tossed up outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside leg stump, Pujara sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Going down leg, Pujara looks to flick it fine but misses.
A bit flatter on a length on middle, turning sharply. Rahane adjusts late and defends it towards the off side.
On a length, spinning away. Rahane plays it with soft hands towards point.
Tossed up around off, Rahane pushes it towards the cover region.
Tossed up around leg stump, Pujara sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Floated up on off, driven to long on for a single.
Full around middle, Pujara clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Pujara drives it with the spin towards mid on.

That's a beautiful delivery! Tossed up outside off, Pujara looks to run it down to third man with an angled blade but the ball whizzes through between the gap of his bat and pads and through to the keeper.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! A bit short outside off, spinning in. Pujara waits for it and guides with an open bat face towards third man for a superb boundary.
Similar length again, Rahane cuts it behind point but fails to find the gap.
A tad short outside off, Pujara stays back and cuts it towards point.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Flighted ball, swept behind square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Shot! A tad short, Pujara waits for it and cuts it late behind point for a cracking boundary.
A bit wide outside off, Pujara cuts it towards point.
Ajinkya Rahane walks out to bat.

OUT! The skipper departs! Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Kohli kneels and goes for the sweep but misses the line of the ball and is rapped low on the pads. There is a big shout for an LBW and the umpire adjudges it out. It looked close to the naked eye. The replays show that the impact may be outside off.
Floated up on off, Kohli pushes it towards short cover.
Floated up outside off, Pujara sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven nicely through the covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara goes for a full fledged sweep but only manages to get from the inside half of his bat in front of square leg for a single.
Floated up on middle and off, flicked towards mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Quicker one around middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Pujara fetches it from outside off and sweeps it nicely through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Innovative from Pujara! Tossed up on off, Pujara kneels and paddles it round the corner and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Floated up on off, Kohli digs out back towards the bowler.
A tad short outside off, Pujara waits for it and punches it through covers for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flatter outside off, chopped towards point for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the non striker's end but Kohli is safely in.
Tossed up outside off, coming in with the angle. Kohli goes for the booming drive but is beaten.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it. One run added to the total.
A bit quicker and short outside off, Pujara guides it to third man for a single.
Pujara drives it with the spin towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara comes down and looks to flick but is rapped on the pads.

FOUR! Short outside off, Kohli waits for it and cuts it through backward point. Ronchi in the deep puts in a good effort. The umpires go upstairs to check for the boundary and the replays show that he failed to keep the ball in play. LEAD IS OF 400 NOW!
Floated up around off, Kohli looks to cut but only gets a bottom edge towards the off side. He perhaps misjudged the length a bit.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Pujara sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Pujara looks to glide it to third man but gets beaten.
Tossed up on off, Kohli makes room and drives on the up and does enough to clear the man at covers for a single.

Appeal for an LBW turned down! Arm ball from Santner, Virat stays back to defend but seems that he got an inside edge onto his pads. There is a loud appeal from the Kiwis but the umpire is unmoved. The replays confirm that there was a faint inside edge.
Full on middle and off, driven back towards the bowler who stops it with one hand.
Flighted delivery around middle, Kohli comes down the track and drives it hard through mid off for a single.
Full on off, Kohli works it craftily through mid-wicket for a brisk couple.
Floated up outside off, Kohli looks to flick it but misses and is rapped low on the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up on a length, spinning in. Pujara waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
Jeetan Patel to continue from the other end.
Tossed up on leg stump, Pujara works it behind square leg for a single.
Pujara drives it towards short mid on

FOUR! Good shot! Shortish again on off, stays a bit low. Pujara stays back and pulls it fiercely through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and dives to his right but couldn't save the boundary.
Shortish ball outside off, Kohli rocks back and cuts it through point for a single.
A tad short and quicker on middle, Kohli stays back and defends it towards covers.
Tossed up around off, driven nicely towards short cover.
The players are out in the middle. It promises to be a session full of action. Let's see how it pans out. Kohli to face, Santner to continue his spell.
...Day 4, Session 2...

The Kiwi fielders were terrific in the field and they deserve a special mention. The bowlers also tried hard but failed to cause any real jitters. Pujara and Kohli would look to come out and score quick runs in the second session. A declaration might just be around the corner after they bat for an hour or so. Join us for the post lunch session.

Gambhir looked calm and composed in the middle and batted with grit and aggression to score a half century. He would be disappointed that he got out just after that but he was looking to score quickly for the home side. Pujara has carried on his good form and has scored a sensible half century as well.

India have pressed the advantage further as the lead has swelled to 385. They scored 109 runs in 28 overs for the loss of two wickets. The Black Caps struck early today as Guptill sent Vijay back to the hut with a brilliant piece of fielding. Gambhir came back to bat and continued his innings after he injured his shoulder yesterday.
FOUR BYES! Down the leg side, Pujara goes for the sweep but misses. The keeper fails to stop the ball as well which eventually goes to the fence. The umpire signals byes. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Landed on off, Pujara blocks it out off his front foot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
11th Test fifty for Pujara!
Around off, Pujara taps it to the off side for a quick single. That brings up his fifty as well. He raises his bat and acknowledges the crowd and his wife.
FOUR! Delicate! Landed outside off, Pujara guides it late to the third man region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence.
Tad short outside off, Pujara punches it away off his back foot.

Full on off, Kohli covers the line and defends.

Appeal for LBW turned down! Quicker through the air and coming on with the angle, Pujara prods forward to defend but misses. There is a loud shout for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it was probably going down leg.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Mitchell Santner comes on to bowl.
VIRAT KOHLI is the next man in.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Fine knock though by Gambhir! Tossed up outside off, Gautam comes down the track and tries to go inside out. He fails to keep it down as the ball goes straight to Guptill at covers. Gambhir walks back but that was a very good knock. Played for the team.
Way down the leg side, Gambhir tries to flick but misses.
Driven through mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, Pujara gets a leading edge on this occasion.
Flighted on off, Pujara drives it to covers.
In the corridor outside off, Pujara fails to put his bat on the ball.
22nd Test fifty for Gautam Gambhir!

FIFTY! Fullish on off, Gautam Gambhir drives it towards mid off and takes a single. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the non-striker's end but misses his shy. Extra run taken and that brings up his fifty as well. The crowd erupts. What a knock this has been.

Length ball on off, Gambhir flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Gambhir is dealing in boundaries suddenly. On the pads, flicked away through the mid-wicket region. The ball races away to the fence yet again. Runs are coming quickly for India here.
Fullish on off, Pujara drives it back to the bowler.
Landed around off, Gautam comes forward and pushes it towards Guptill at short mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tad short outside off, Gambhir goes onto his back foot and guides it late to the third man region for a boundary.
Landed around off, Gambhir defends it into the ground.
On middle and off, Cheteshwar works it through the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, Pujara covers the line and defends.

Fullish length ball around off, Gambhir taps it towards point and sets off for a run. Pujara is not interested and sends him back. Boult comes running in and throws at the keeper's end and hits the stumps. There is an appeal for a run out and it is referred upstairs. The replays show that he was comfortably in.

Dropped! Slow through the air outside off, spinning in. Gambhir strides forward to defend but gets a faint nick towards the keeper who fails to grab it. Need to take those if you want to fight back in the match.

Well bowled! Flighted ball, spinning away sharply. Pujara is on the front foot looking to defend but is beaten by the extra spin away from is bat and the ball whizzes through to the keeper.
Tossed up around off, driven towards the covers.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Shortish delivery, Pujara camps back and pulls through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Lucky for Gambhir! Full length ball outside off, Gambhir strides forward and commits to the drive but gets a bottom edge wide past gully and the ball races the third man fence.

Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Gambhir works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Gautam Gambhir is back to bat.

OUT! Brilliant piece of work from Guptill! Tossed up, Vijay pushes it towards covers and sets off for a single. He has probably misjudged it as Pujara is not interested and sends his back. Guptill from short cover comes running in and dives to his left and makes a back handed flick to the keeper on the go. Watling flicks the bails in a jiffy. Vijay seems to be just short. The run out appeal has been referred upstairs. The Kiwis are looking confident out there. The replays show that Vijay is just short of his crease and Vijay has to depart. Lazy effort from the Indian opener there and he has to play for it.
The run out appeal against Vijay has been referred upstairs.

Arm ball from Santner on middle. Vijay looks to defend but gets an inside edge on to his pads. There is a loud appeal from the Kiwis but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that there was a clear inside edge.

Neeham who is stationed there just in front of the boundary jumps high in the air and holds the ball. But as the momentum would have taken him behind the boundary, he pushes the ball inside. The players are out in the middle and Murali Vijay and Cheteshwar Pujara will continue their overnight batting. Matt Henry to start the proceedings for New Zealand first up. Here we go...

Hello and a warm welcome on Day 4 of the final Test match between India and New Zealand. The home side are truly in the driver's seat as they lead by 276 runs. They would look to score big and draw curtains on the Kiwis on a pitch that is offering a good amount of turn and bounce to the spinners. If the visiting side are to entertain any thoughts of a draw or a victory, they have to play out of their skins.
...Day 4, Session 1...

India will look to bat somewhere around Tea tomorrow. Let's see how the Kiwis fight back from this position now. Should be another exciting day of Test cricket so do join us back at 0930 IST to catch the day 4 action. Until then, goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Superb day for India! They have seen off the tricky little period but have suffered a blow. Gautam Gambhir injured his shoulder and went off the field, retired hurt. They're on top though in this match as they lead by 276 runs. Earlier in the day, they bundled out the Kiwis just under 300 with Ravichandran Ashwin being the destroyer-in-chief as the offie grabbed a 6-fer.

Drama to end the day! Quicker outside off, comes in with the angle, Pujara looks to cut it but misses. The Kiwis go up in an appeal but the umpire says no. Replays show the ball hit the pad and not the bat. Good call from the umpire. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 3!

Played through the point region for a single by Pujara.

Comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.

Shorter outside off, Vijay plays this one towards the third man region. Vijay is again running on the danger area. He is warned officially. India already had Jadeja fined for running on the danger area while batting in the first innings.
